summary: Willamette NF lookout east of Oakridge: a 1915 tent, then a 1917 frame cab staffed in 1920; the cab is now gone and no remains on the summit are described.

notes_for_editor: Lookout is gone; no source describes what remains on the summit, so the story says so. Staffing rests on 1920 and 1922 newspaper items reprinted second-hand by Oregon Lookouts; the 1920 name is spelled three ways (L. E., Lewis, Lew Flock). Elevation: register gives 3,400 ft for the lookout site, Wikipedia 3,682 ft for the summit; not reconciled. The record's access 'unknown' is set to public on the basis of national forest trail access. The Oregon Hikers post is used only for access. The record's elevation_m 1036.3 matches the register figure for the lookout site.
